metadata.title: TON 618 NASA Black Marble — Lebanon nationwide ADM3 September comparison
metadata.observation_type: Mean over sampled pixels of monthly median quality-screened daily radiance; 3 good nights per pixel minimum
metadata.geometry_source: Lebanon Atlas ADM3 cadastral polygons (corrected Earth Engine asset)
notes: Pixel counts are spatial samples, not numbers of independent nightly observations.
Small villages / few sampled pixels make percent-change comparisons especially uncertain.
Changes in nighttime radiance do not directly measure building destruction, conflict damage, or aid needs.
2025 and 2026 reductions can use different valid pixel sets; compare as exploratory satellite indicators.
Historical study-area population and IOM hosted displacement must not be added to this brightness metric.
17 boundary features with ambiguous code 0 are excluded from coded joins.
